item.text: Slide 2 already has an empty title placeholder in the PPTX. I’ll fill that placeholder with `Note`, set its paragraph alignment to right, then reopen the file in Impress so the visible document matches the saved file.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import shutil, tempfile, os

pptx = Path('/home/user/Desktop/22_6.pptx')
backup = pptx.with_suffix('.pptx.bak_codex')
if not backup.exists():
    shutil.copy2(pptx, backup)

ns = {
    'p': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main',
    'a': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main',
}
ET.register_namespace('a', ns['a'])
ET.register_namespace('p', ns['p'])
ET.register_namespace('r', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships')
ET.register_namespace('p14', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main')
ET.register_namespace('p15', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2012/main')
ET.register_namespace('mc', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006')

with ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as zin:
    entries = {info.filename: zin.read(info.filename) for info in zin.infolist()}

slide_name = 'ppt/slides/slide2.xml'
root = ET.fromstring(entries[slide_name])
spTree = root.find('.//p:spTree', ns)
changed = False
for sp in spTree.findall('p:sp', ns):
    ph = sp.find('./p:nvSpPr/p:nvPr/p:ph', ns)
    if ph is not None and ph.get('type') == 'title':
        tx = sp.find('p:txBody', ns)
        p = tx.find('a:p', ns)
        # Remove existing run text in this empty placeholder while preserving endParaRPr.
        for child in list(p):
            if child.tag.endswith('}r'):
                p.remove(child)
        pPr = p.find('a:pPr', ns)
        if pPr is None:
            pPr = ET.Element(f'{{{ns[\"a\"]}}}pPr')
            p.insert(0, pPr)
        pPr.set('algn', 'r')
        end = p.find('a:endParaRPr', ns)
        if end is None:
            end = ET.Element(f'{{{ns[\"a\"]}}}endParaRPr', {'lang':'en-US', 'sz':'1800'})
            p.append(end)
        r = ET.Element(f'{{{ns[\"a\"]}}}r')
        rPr = ET.SubElement(r, f'{{{ns[\"a\"]}}}rPr', {'lang':'en-US', 'sz': end.get('sz', '1800')})
        solid = ET.SubElement(rPr, f'{{{ns[\"a\"]}}}solidFill')
        ET.SubElement(solid, f'{{{ns[\"a\"]}}}srgbClr', {'val':'000000'})
        ET.SubElement(rPr, f'{{{ns[\"a\"]}}}latin', {'typeface':'Calibri'})
        t = ET.SubElement(r, f'{{{ns[\"a\"]}}}t')
        t.text = 'Note'
        insert_at = list(p).index(end) if end in list(p) else len(list(p))
        p.insert(insert_at, r)
        changed = True
        break

if not changed:
    raise SystemExit('Could not find slide 2 title placeholder')
entries[slide_name] = ET.tostring(root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True, short_empty_elements=True)

fd, tmpname = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.pptx', dir=str(pptx.parent))
os.close(fd)
try:
    with ZipFile(tmpname, 'w', ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        with ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as zin:
            for info in zin.infolist():
                data = entries[info.filename]
                zout.writestr(info, data)
    shutil.copystat(pptx, tmpname)
    os.replace(tmpname, pptx)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmpname):
        os.unlink(tmpname)
print('updated slide 2 title placeholder')
PY
unzip -p /home/user/Desktop/22_6.pptx ppt/slides/slide2.xml | rg -o '<a:pPr["'^>]*>|<a:t>[''^<]*</a:t>'"'"
